couplets.en: I have tried so often to soothe this restless heart.

lines: Magar is dil ne tadpaya bahut hai
couplets.en: Yet this heart has kept me aching.
I have tried so often to soothe this restless heart.
There is a quiet devastation in giving up desire.

lines: Mujhe aksar woh yaad aaya bahut hai
couplets.en: How often, how vividly, you have come to mind.

lines: Tabassum bhi, haya bhi, be-rukhi bhi
couplets.en: There was a smile, a trace of shyness, and a turning away.
I found myself drawn to that way you had of hurting me.

lines: Raah-e-hasti ke is jalte safar mein
couplets.en: Life is a road that burns beneath my feet.

lines: Tumhari yaad ka saaya bahut hai
couplets.en: The memory of you is shade enough.
